CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sri_quality_category(sri numeric)
RETURNS text IMMUTABLE AS $$
SELECT CASE 
    WHEN sri IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN sri < 2.0 THEN 'Excellent'
    WHEN sri < 3.0 THEN 'Good'
    WHEN sri < 4.0 THEN 'Fair'
    ELSE 'Poor'
END;
$$ LANGUAGE sql;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION test_sri_functions(res_mm numeric, dens integer)
RETURNS TABLE(sri_value numeric, quality_category text) AS $$
    SELECT calculate_sri(res_mm, dens), sri_quality_category(calculate_sri(res_mm, dens));
$$ LANGUAGE sql;
